dimensions.note: A cross-case pattern recurs in all six readings: generous valuation beside self-serving use of access, advice and others' activities (B0205 B and D; B0232 case 21; B0239 P23-30), together with real creative commitment (B0205 D; B0247 CL-033, -042) and a specific band attachment (B0239 QOP). B0253 adds an admitted confidante role used as imagined romantic opportunity and a voyeuristic 萌え benefit. The pattern is named and countered in each reading, so D; no conditional rule or validated model is derived, so not C.

Every reading refuses a chronology across occurrences, and B0205 and B0239 explicitly refuse to read gratitude or a corrected boast as reform. Only intra-family chapter order is available (B0247 1-5, B0253 and B0254 1-6), with local turns such as the post-live renewal and the coda protest. The main-story states the readings cite are uncurated.

More located Japanese than before: B0253 quotes Type反抗期型ウイルス, 絶対に阻止してみせる, プリィィィィズ, 恋愛相談イコール, 間違いない, めんこい, 治さなくていい, ぐぬぬ, しめしめ, ギクッッ and 誰も傷つかないハッピーエンド; B0254 quotes おにゃのこ and やだ; B0205 locates a few phrases. Elsewhere her speech is paraphrased, written laughter and elongation are typographic, and no WAV in any reading was heard, so these are scattered lexical cues rather than a register model.

Ordinary activity is mostly reported (B0205 shopping, rainy-day reading, an overslept meet; B0247 festival manuscript work). Instrument shopping is enacted in conversation (B0247 ch4) and the camp gives daily-routine settings (B0254), but her part there is fantasy, proposals and a body question. No routine is modeled.

Counterparts now answer: Ferb affirms her appearance, chooses her guitar, objects to the embrace and denies the wife claim (B0247); Makoto and Susu accept her advice, protect her and acknowledge a debt (B0253); the manager corrects the unlimited-touching claim (B0239) and challenges her diagnosis-like claims, drawing an apology (B0253); Coney proposes the solitary camp and she protests (B0254); Sumire qualifies her group-pleasure reading (B0254). These are differentiated but single-occasion, so D, not C.

Interior states are spoken self-reports: the advice pretext (B0205 B), surprise and overload at her birthday and QOP as her most important encounter (B0239), and the admitted 萌え benefit (B0253 ch6). No inward narration is distinguished from speech, and the B0253 backstage account is not shown disclosed to the manager.

Friction recurs and is analyzed across contexts: an embrace that meets an explicit objection and continued wife and vow claims after a denial (B0247 CL-050); an announced intention to obstruct and an actual comic interruption followed by apology and ぐぬぬ (B0253 ch1, ch4); challenge and apology (B0253 ch6); やだ against the solitary camp (B0254 ch6); the reported flight (B0239). No escalation logic or resolution pattern is derived.

Stated values are local: equal cuteness forbids ranking and Haru's costume is hers alone (B0205 C, E); her ending appraisal that nobody was hurt (B0253 ch6) is hers. The readings analyze appropriation of permission and absent peer assent (B0205 B, D; B0239 P23-24; B0232) rather than any deliberation she performs.

Comic play is analyzed as her own register in every reading: the limited joking allowance and old-man-inside uptake (B0205 A, B), the goddess appraisal and playful 'mean' reproach (B0239), the fictional-senior reveal (B0247 CL-042), the virus taxonomy, ズコー and self-corrected 萌え (B0253 ch1) and the camp fantasies (B0254). The readings deny that play transfers permission over others.

Each curated unit is complete as a source unit, and three are full multi-chapter Events. All are side material (Intimacy, Short message, Birthday, Event); the main-story readings the readings rely on for her resistant prior states are uncurated, no performed audio was heard, and B0247, B0253 and B0254 were read through her sections and the family syntheses.

Affirmative limits are repeated and located: the unlimited-touching claim is corrected and recipients flee (B0239 P23-30); Ferb objects to the embrace and denies the wife claim (B0247 CL-050); the apology concerns her excitement and is followed by continued appraisal (B0232); her obstruction has limited effect (B0253 ch4); the solitary-camp proposal is protested (B0254 ch6); peers' assent is never supplied (B0205).

The readings establish that no chronology, calendar, year or unlock level orders the occurrences and that none is placed relative to Main; B0239 gives only relative birthday dates and B0247 an elided live.

dimensions.note: The reading's cumulative finding is attention that is generous in valuation and self-serving in use: an objection to ranking peers' photographs (C:P3), a refusal to wear Haru's costume (E:P5) and a stated quality standard for her comic (D:P1-P2) sit beside an admitted advice pretext (B:P1-P2) and the conversion of general advice into a claimed endorsement (D:P3-P4). The cross-case pattern is sharper than a single trait, so it is graded; each address is three to five pages and no conditional rule is derived, so D is not supported.

The reading affirmatively forbids reading the seven occurrences as reform or as one calendar, and keeps F's book and G's manga, and C's and E's shopping, as separate occasions. Earlier Yumeno states (B0093-B0202) are context only and not enrolled.

A few phrases are located: accepting the old-man-inside joke (B:P3), flowers in both hands and ascension as appraisals (E), super maid-advisor (E:P3-P4), the claimed manager-approved plan (D:P4) and the self-repair from appreciating to watching the competition (G:P5). Otherwise her Japanese is paraphrased and the 31 voice cues were not heard.

Ordinary activities are reported, not shown: shopping for booklets in Akiba Seven (C), buying cloth with Rishuri and Ayumu (E), a rainy day at home with a borrowed book (F), reading a manga until dawn and oversleeping (G), and an unfinished comic for a manga-club bulletin (D). No routine is enacted.

Yumeno is the sole named speaking actor in all 31 records; the manager's compliments, advice and looks reach the reader only through her uptake, and Rishuri, Ayumu, Kazumi, Rena, Kyoko, Honoka and Haru never speak. One located differentiation (Haru's costume as hers alone, E:P5) does not support recipient conditioning.

Interior states are spoken self-reports, including an unusually direct admission of a concealed motive behind her advice role (B:P1-P2), dissatisfaction with her comic ideas (D:P1) and regret at the missed meet (G). No inward narration is distinguished from speech, and the reading does not supply her inner account in others' testimony.

Only brief, local friction is analyzed: she objects to what she reads as the manager's suspicious look and offers Kazumi as corroboration (F:P2-P3), briefly challenges his compliment (A:P3) and objects to the shop's ranking (C:P3). No escalation, sustained dispute or another person's resistance is shown.

Two stated value judgments are located: equal cuteness makes ranking unacceptable (C:P3) and Haru's exclusive costume is unthinkable for her to wear (E:P5). The reading treats both as local, and analyzes her pretext (B) and claimed endorsement (D) as appropriation without peer assent. That supports bounded canon questions about stated values, not a deliberation process.

The reading analyzes joking explicitly: suggestive amusement and a limited joking allowance (A:P2-P3), acceptance of the old-man-inside remark (B:P3), comic fitness claims (B:P4-P5) and extravagant appraisal language (E). It denies that the joking allowance transfers permission over others.

The family is complete: seven occurrences with exact scripts and hashes, all 38 native page states and 31 records read, one composite and three backgrounds viewed, and 155 context rows compared. It is still seven short addresses; the earlier readings, which the reading cites for pressure and refusal, are not enrolled, and no performed audio was reviewed.

Affirmative limits are located: the peers' assent is never supplied in A, B, D or G; the manager has no line endorsing D's plan; she cannot find a satisfying comic idea (D:P1); and she oversleeps and misses Rena's meet (G:P1-P2). The reading states that none of the independent cases is reform.
The reading establishes that no chronology, calendar or unlock level orders the occurrences, and that the meet in G is not identifiable with any earlier Rena episode.
